findings.late_response_boundary: old unparsed admission is removed and already-parsed old responses lose both core and GUI lookup keys
findings.notification_boundary: token-addressed search notifications are wishlist-only, and wishlist is excluded
findings.official_consumer_closure: all in-tree and supported plugin/API token consumers are classified for ordinary searches
findings.ordering_boundary: core and GUI identities rekey synchronously before the new request is sent
findings.packet_split: ordinary rekey mechanics and wishlist product semantics are now separate packets
findings.plugin_boundary: documented outgoing search hooks expose no wire token and repeat reuses the processed request
findings.recently_closed_boundary: restore payload is logical search data and creates a new search rather than retaining a wire token
findings.unsupported_extension_boundary: third-party code importing internal dictionaries cannot be enumerated or guaranteed

source.scope: executable proxy plus separate current-public-flow observation

upstream_unit_evidence_reuse.mode: digest-bound reuse; no redundant upstream unit rerun
